p: ways: God approves not our life, unless it is reformed according to his word.
hands: The world esteems them happy who live in wealth and idleness but the Holy Spirit approves them best who live of the mean profit of their labours.
children like olive plants round about: Because God's favour appears in no outward thing more than in the increase of children, he promises to enrich the faithful with this gift.
bless thee out of Zion: Because of the spiritual blessing which God has made to his Church, these temporal things will be granted.
Jerusalem all the days of thy: For unless God blessed his Church publicly, this private blessing was nothing.
